messages.subject: [ANNOUNCE] Magpie website app
messages.body:
Hello here,

As you might be aware, Apache Magpie was formally established last week by
the Apache Board of Directors.

The "apache-steward" repo has moved to https://github.com/apache/magpie.
Additionally, there is a brand new landing page for Magpie efforts:
https://magpie.apache.org/

We do not yet know what the future holds for Magpie, but the bird is now
officially on its own.

J.
